20	CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION commission_splits_drift_check(p_since_timestamp timestamptz)
21	RETURNS jsonb
22	LANGUAGE plpgsql
23	STABLE
24	SECURITY DEFINER
25	SET search_path = public
26	AS $$
27	DECLARE
28	  v_pis_missing jsonb;
29	  v_disputes_missing jsonb;
30	  v_charges_missing_tax_line jsonb;
31	BEGIN
32	  -- Leg 1: PIs that succeeded but have no commission_splits row of kind='split'
33	  SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
34	    'payment_intent_id', sc.payment_intent_id,
35	    'charge_id', sc.charge_id,
36	    'studio_id', sc.studio_id,
37	    'created_at', sc.created_at
38	  )), '[]'::jsonb)
39	  INTO v_pis_missing
40	  FROM stripe_charges sc
41	  LEFT JOIN commission_splits cs
42	    ON cs.booking_id = sc.booking_id AND cs.kind = 'split'
43	  WHERE sc.status = 'succeeded'
44	    AND sc.created_at >= p_since_timestamp
45	    AND cs.id IS NULL
46	    AND sc.booking_id IS NOT NULL;
47	
48	  -- Leg 2: Disputes lost without a corresponding kind='reversal' commission_splits row
49	  SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
50	    'dispute_id', sd.dispute_id,
51	    'charge_id', sd.charge_id,
52	    'studio_id', sd.studio_id,
53	    'resolved_at', sd.resolved_at
54	  )), '[]'::jsonb)
55	  INTO v_disputes_missing
56	  FROM stripe_disputes sd
57	  WHERE sd.status = 'lost'
58	    AND sd.resolved_at >= p_since_timestamp
59	    AND NOT EXISTS (
60	      SELECT 1 FROM commission_splits cs
61	      WHERE cs.kind = 'reversal'
62	        AND cs.created_at >= sd.resolved_at - interval '1 hour'
63	        AND cs.created_at <= sd.resolved_at + interval '24 hours'
64	        AND cs.studio_id = sd.studio_id
65	        AND cs.booking_id IN (
66	          SELECT booking_id FROM stripe_charges WHERE charge_id = sd.charge_id LIMIT 1
67	        )
68	    );
69	
70	  -- Leg 3 (S17 Sage H1 fix): succeeded charges with tax_amount_cents > 0 missing tax_line attribution.
71	  -- A parent split exists (Leg 1 would catch missing parent), but no kind='tax_line' children.
72	  -- This means Track A's commission_split_tax_line_record call failed and went un-reconciled.
73	  SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
74	    'payment_intent_id', sc.payment_intent_id,
75	    'charge_id', sc.charge_id,
76	    'studio_id', sc.studio_id,
77	    'tax_amount_cents', sc.tax_amount_cents
78	  )), '[]'::jsonb)
79	  INTO v_charges_missing_tax_line
80	  FROM stripe_charges sc
81	  INNER JOIN commission_splits parent
82	    ON parent.booking_id = sc.booking_id AND parent.kind = 'split'
83	  LEFT JOIN commission_splits taxlines
84	    ON taxlines.parent_split_id = parent.id AND taxlines.kind = 'tax_line'
85	  WHERE sc.status = 'succeeded'
86	    AND sc.created_at >= p_since_timestamp
87	    AND sc.booking_id IS NOT NULL
88	    AND sc.tax_amount_cents > 0
89	    AND taxlines.id IS NULL;
90	
91	  RETURN jsonb_build_object(
92	    'pis_missing_split', v_pis_missing,
93	    'disputes_missing_reversal', v_disputes_missing,
94	    'charges_missing_tax_line', v_charges_missing_tax_line
95	  );
96	END;
97	$$;
98	
99	COMMENT ON FUNCTION commission_splits_drift_check(timestamptz) IS
100	  'S17. Read-only drift detector for reconciliation cron. 3 legs: PIs missing split, disputes missing reversal, charges with tax_amount > 0 missing tax_line attribution.';
101	
102	REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION commission_splits_drift_check(timestamptz) FROM PUBLIC;
103	GRANT  EXECUTE ON FUNCTION commission_splits_drift_check(timestamptz) TO service_role;

113	-- Spec : TaxRemittanceReleaseArgs → TaxRemittanceReleaseResult
114	-- Name : RPC.TAX_REMITTANCE_RELEASE = 'tax_remittance_release'
115	-- Params:
116	--   p_studio_id            uuid
117	--   p_location_id          uuid
118	--   p_jurisdiction         text
119	--   p_period               text
120	--   p_release_amount_cents bigint
121	--   p_idempotency_key      text
122	--   p_refund_id            text
123	-- Returns: jsonb { ledger_id, new_collected_cents, released_cents }
124	-- Idempotent: UNIQUE tax_remittance_releases.idempotency_key
125	-- Volatile: writes to tax_remittance_ledger + tax_remittance_releases
126	-- Grant: service_role ONLY
127	-- =============================================================================
128	
129	CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION tax_remittance_release(
130	  p_studio_id            uuid,
131	  p_location_id          uuid,
132	  p_jurisdiction         text,
133	  p_period               text,
134	  p_release_amount_cents bigint,
135	  p_idempotency_key      text,
136	  p_refund_id            text
137	)
138	RETURNS jsonb
139	LANGUAGE plpgsql
140	VOLATILE
141	SECURITY DEFINER
142	SET search_path = public
143	AS $$
144	DECLARE
145	  v_ledger           RECORD;
146	  v_existing_release RECORD;
147	  v_new_collected    bigint;
148	BEGIN
149	  -- ── Input validation ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
150	  IF p_release_amount_cents IS NULL OR p_release_amount_cents <= 0 THEN
151	    RAISE EXCEPTION
152	      'tax_remittance_release: release_amount_cents must be > 0, got %',
153	      p_release_amount_cents;
154	  END IF;
155	
156	  IF p_idempotency_key IS NULL OR length(trim(p_idempotency_key)) = 0 THEN
157	    RAISE EXCEPTION
158	      'tax_remittance_release: idempotency_key must not be null or empty';
159	  END IF;
160	
161	  IF p_refund_id IS NULL OR length(trim(p_refund_id)) = 0 THEN
162	    RAISE EXCEPTION
163	      'tax_remittance_release: refund_id must not be null or empty';
164	  END IF;
165	
166	  -- ── Idempotency check ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
167	  -- If a previous call with the same idempotency_key already committed,
168	  -- return the cached result without touching the ledger again.
169	  SELECT trr.id, trr.ledger_id, trr.released_cents
170	    INTO v_existing_release
171	    FROM tax_remittance_releases trr
172	   WHERE trr.idempotency_key = p_idempotency_key;
173	
174	  IF FOUND THEN
175	    SELECT trl.amount_collected_cents
176	      INTO v_new_collected
177	      FROM tax_remittance_ledger trl
178	     WHERE trl.id = v_existing_release.ledger_id;
179	
180	    RETURN jsonb_build_object(
181	      'ledger_id',           v_existing_release.ledger_id,
182	      'new_collected_cents', v_new_collected,
183	      'released_cents',      v_existing_release.released_cents
184	    );
185	  END IF;
186	
187	  -- ── Lock ledger row ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
188	  -- SELECT FOR UPDATE serialises concurrent releases on the same ledger row.
189	  SELECT trl.id, trl.amount_collected_cents
190	    INTO v_ledger
191	    FROM tax_remittance_ledger trl
192	   WHERE trl.studio_id    = p_studio_id
193	     AND trl.location_id  = p_location_id
194	     AND trl.jurisdiction = p_jurisdiction
195	     AND trl.period       = p_period
196	  FOR UPDATE;
197	
198	  IF NOT FOUND THEN
199	    RAISE EXCEPTION
200	      'tax_remittance_release: ledger row not found for '
201	      '(studio=%, location=%, jurisdiction=%, period=%)',
202	      p_studio_id, p_location_id, p_jurisdiction, p_period;
203	  END IF;
204	
205	  -- ── Bounds check ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
206	  -- Prevents amount_collected_cents going negative — the table CHECK constraint
207	  -- (tax_remittance_ledger_collected_pos) would also catch this, but an explicit
208	  -- exception is far more informative for ops debugging.
209	  IF v_ledger.amount_collected_cents < p_release_amount_cents THEN
210	    RAISE EXCEPTION
211	      'tax_remittance_release: release % exceeds collected % '
212	      '(ledger_id=%, studio=%, jurisdiction=%, period=%)',
213	      p_release_amount_cents,
214	      v_ledger.amount_collected_cents,
215	      v_ledger.id,
216	      p_studio_id,
217	      p_jurisdiction,
218	      p_period;
219	  END IF;
220	
221	  -- ── Decrement collected ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
222	  UPDATE tax_remittance_ledger
223	     SET amount_collected_cents = amount_collected_cents - p_release_amount_cents
224	   WHERE id = v_ledger.id
225	   RETURNING amount_collected_cents INTO v_new_collected;
226	
227	  -- ── Record release for idempotency + audit ──────────────────────────────────
228	  INSERT INTO tax_remittance_releases (
229	    ledger_id,
230	    idempotency_key,
231	    refund_id,
232	    released_cents
233	  ) VALUES (
234	    v_ledger.id,
235	    p_idempotency_key,
236	    p_refund_id,
237	    p_release_amount_cents
238	  );
239	
240	  RETURN jsonb_build_object(
241	    'ledger_id',           v_ledger.id,
242	    'new_collected_cents', v_new_collected,
243	    'released_cents',      p_release_amount_cents
244	  );
245	END;

248	COMMENT ON FUNCTION tax_remittance_release(uuid, uuid, text, text, bigint, text, text) IS
249	  'S18. Refund-driven re-credit of tax_remittance_ledger.amount_collected_cents. '
250	  'Idempotent on p_idempotency_key via tax_remittance_releases tracking table. '
251	  'SELECT FOR UPDATE serialises concurrent releases on the same ledger row. '
252	  'Raises if release amount exceeds collected (prevents negative balance).';

257

259	-- SECTION 4 — UNIQUE partial index for commission_split tax_line reversal idempotency
260	--
261	-- Encodes refund_id into tax_line_id as 'refund:<refund_id>:<original_tax_line_id>'
262	-- on kind='reversal' rows that represent a tax_line reversal. The UNIQUE index on
263	-- (parent_split_id, tax_line_id) WHERE kind='reversal' AND tax_line_id LIKE 'refund:%'
264	-- prevents duplicate reversal rows for the same (parent_tax_line_split_id, refund_id).
265	-- Must be created BEFORE Section 5 (the RPC that depends on it for idempotency checks).
266	-- =============================================================================
267	
268	CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS uniq_commission_splits_tax_line_reversal
269	  ON commission_splits (parent_split_id, tax_line_id)
270	  WHERE kind = 'reversal'
271	    AND tax_line_id LIKE 'refund:%';
272	
273	
274	-- =============================================================================
275	-- SECTION 5 — RPC: commission_split_tax_line_reverse
276	--
277	-- Spec : CommissionSplitTaxLineReverseArgs → CommissionSplitTaxLineReverseResult
278	-- Name : RPC.COMMISSION_SPLIT_TAX_LINE_REVERSE = 'commission_split_tax_line_reverse'
279	-- Params:
280	--   p_parent_tax_line_split_id uuid   — id of the kind='tax_line' row to reverse
281	--   p_release_tax_cents        bigint — amount to reverse (positive integer)
282	--   p_refund_id                text   — Stripe refund_xxx identifier
283	--   p_idempotency_key          text   — caller idempotency key (unused for DB check
284	--                                       — DB idempotency is via the UNIQUE index;
285	--                                       param retained for API contract parity)
286	-- Returns: jsonb { reversal_id, total_reversed_cents, created }
287	-- Idempotent: uniq_commission_splits_tax_line_reversal on
288	--             (parent_split_id, 'refund:<refund_id>:<original_tax_line_id>')
289	--             WHERE kind='reversal'
290	-- Volatile: INSERTs into commission_splits
291	-- Grant: service_role ONLY
292	--
293	-- Design notes:
294	--   tax_line_id on the reversal row is 'refund:<refund_id>:<original_tax_line_id>'.
295	--   This encodes both the refund context and original tax_line_id in a single
296	--   indexed column, enabling the UNIQUE partial index to catch replays.
297	--   tax_amount_cents is stored as a negative value (ledger netting pattern, CC4).
298	--   The commission_splits_tax_amount_cents_check constraint allows negatives
299	--   only when kind='reversal', which this row satisfies.
300	-- =============================================================================
301	
302	CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION commission_split_tax_line_reverse(
303	  p_parent_tax_line_split_id uuid,
304	  p_release_tax_cents        bigint,
305	  p_refund_id                text,
306	  p_idempotency_key          text
307	)
308	RETURNS jsonb
309	LANGUAGE plpgsql
310	VOLATILE
311	SECURITY DEFINER
312	SET search_path = public
313	AS $$
314	DECLARE
315	  v_existing        RECORD;
316	  v_parent          RECORD;
317	  v_already_reversed bigint;
318	  v_reversal_tax_line_id text;
319	  v_new_reversal_id uuid;
320	BEGIN
321	  -- ── Input validation ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
322	  IF p_release_tax_cents IS NULL OR p_release_tax_cents <= 0 THEN
323	    RAISE EXCEPTION
324	      'commission_split_tax_line_reverse: release_tax_cents must be > 0, got %',
325	      p_release_tax_cents;
326	  END IF;
327	
328	  IF p_refund_id IS NULL OR length(trim(p_refund_id)) = 0 THEN
329	    RAISE EXCEPTION
330	      'commission_split_tax_line_reverse: refund_id must not be null or empty';
331	  END IF;
332	
333	  IF p_idempotency_key IS NULL OR length(trim(p_idempotency_key)) = 0 THEN
334	    RAISE EXCEPTION
335	      'commission_split_tax_line_reverse: idempotency_key must not be null or empty';
336	  END IF;
337	
338	  -- ── Load parent tax_line row first (needed for reversal tax_line_id encoding) ──
339	  -- SELECT FOR UPDATE prevents concurrent reversals racing on the same parent.
340	  SELECT cs.id,
341	         cs.studio_id,
342	         cs.booking_id,
343	         cs.session_id,
344	         cs.artist_id,
345	         cs.tax_amount_cents,
346	         cs.tax_line_id,
347	         cs.jurisdiction,
348	         cs.kind
349	    INTO v_parent
350	    FROM commission_splits cs
351	   WHERE cs.id = p_parent_tax_line_split_id
352	  FOR UPDATE;
353	
354	  IF NOT FOUND THEN
355	    RAISE EXCEPTION
356	      'commission_split_tax_line_reverse: parent tax_line split % not found',
357	      p_parent_tax_line_split_id;
358	  END IF;
359	
360	  IF v_parent.kind <> 'tax_line' THEN
361	    RAISE EXCEPTION
362	      'commission_split_tax_line_reverse: parent kind must be ''tax_line'', got ''%'' '
363	      'for id=%',
364	      v_parent.kind,
365	      p_parent_tax_line_split_id;
366	  END IF;
367	
368	  -- ── Build encoded tax_line_id for the reversal row ──────────────────────────
369	  -- Format: 'refund:<refund_id>:<original_tax_line_id>'
370	  -- Drives the UNIQUE partial index uniq_commission_splits_tax_line_reversal.
371	  v_reversal_tax_line_id := 'refund:' || p_refund_id || ':' || v_parent.tax_line_id;
372	
373	  -- ── Idempotency check via UNIQUE index ──────────────────────────────────────
374	  -- If a reversal row already exists with this (parent_split_id, encoded tax_line_id)
375	  -- under kind='reversal', the call is a replay — return cached result.
376	  SELECT cs.id
377	    INTO v_existing
378	    FROM commission_splits cs
379	   WHERE cs.parent_split_id = p_parent_tax_line_split_id
380	     AND cs.kind            = 'reversal'
381	     AND cs.tax_line_id     = v_reversal_tax_line_id;
382	
383	  IF FOUND THEN
384	    -- Compute total reversed for informational return
385	    SELECT COALESCE(SUM(-cs.tax_amount_cents), 0)
386	      INTO v_already_reversed
387	      FROM commission_splits cs
388	     WHERE cs.parent_split_id = p_parent_tax_line_split_id
389	       AND cs.kind            = 'reversal';
390	
391	    RETURN jsonb_build_object(
392	      'reversal_id',          v_existing.id,
393	      'total_reversed_cents', v_already_reversed,
394	      'created',              false
395	    );
396	  END IF;
397	
398	  -- ── Cumulative bounds check ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
399	  -- Sum existing reversals (stored as negative values — negate to get positive total).
400	  SELECT COALESCE(SUM(-cs.tax_amount_cents), 0)
401	    INTO v_already_reversed
402	    FROM commission_splits cs
403	   WHERE cs.parent_split_id = p_parent_tax_line_split_id
404	     AND cs.kind            = 'reversal';
405	
406	  IF v_already_reversed + p_release_tax_cents > v_parent.tax_amount_cents THEN
407	    RAISE EXCEPTION
408	      'commission_split_tax_line_reverse: cumulative reversal % would exceed '
409	      'parent tax_amount_cents % (already_reversed=%, requested=%, parent_id=%)',
410	      v_already_reversed + p_release_tax_cents,
411	      v_parent.tax_amount_cents,
412	      v_already_reversed,
413	      p_release_tax_cents,
414	      p_parent_tax_line_split_id;
415	  END IF;
416	
417	  -- ── Insert reversal row ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
418	  -- Non-monetary fields are zero — this row's sole purpose is tax reversal.
419	  -- tax_amount_cents is negative (ledger netting pattern, CC4).
420	  -- commission_splits_tax_amount_cents_check allows negatives when kind='reversal'.
421	  INSERT INTO commission_splits (
422	    studio_id,
423	    booking_id,
424	    session_id,
425	    artist_id,
426	    base_amount_cents,
427	    commission_pct,
428	    tip_amount_cents,
429	    applied_from_pool_cents,
430	    stripe_transfer_id,
431	    kind,
432	    parent_split_id,
433	    tax_amount_cents,
434	    tax_line_id,
435	    jurisdiction
436	  ) VALUES (
437	    v_parent.studio_id,
438	    v_parent.booking_id,
439	    v_parent.session_id,
440	    v_parent.artist_id,
441	    0,                              -- base_amount_cents: zero for tax-reversal rows
442	    0,                              -- commission_pct: zero for tax-reversal rows
443	    0,                              -- tip_amount_cents: zero for tax-reversal rows
444	    0,                              -- applied_from_pool_cents: zero for tax-reversal rows
445	    NULL,                           -- stripe_transfer_id: no transfer for tax reversal
446	    'reversal',
447	    p_parent_tax_line_split_id,
448	    -p_release_tax_cents,           -- negative: ledger netting pattern (CC4)
449	    v_reversal_tax_line_id,         -- 'refund:<refund_id>:<original_tax_line_id>'
450	    v_parent.jurisdiction
451	  )
452	  RETURNING id INTO v_new_reversal_id;
453	
454	  RETURN jsonb_build_object(
455	    'reversal_id',          v_new_reversal_id,
456	    'total_reversed_cents', v_already_reversed + p_release_tax_cents,
457	    'created',              true
458	  );
459	END;
460	$$;

462	COMMENT ON FUNCTION commission_split_tax_line_reverse(uuid, bigint, text, text) IS
463	  'S18. Refund-driven reversal of a kind=tax_line commission_splits row. '
464	  'Inserts a kind=reversal child row with tax_amount_cents=-p_release_tax_cents '
465	  '(ledger netting pattern, CC4). '
466	  'Idempotent on (parent_tax_line_split_id, refund_id) via '
467	  'uniq_commission_splits_tax_line_reversal UNIQUE partial index. '
468	  'tax_line_id on the reversal row is encoded as '
469	  '''refund:<refund_id>:<original_tax_line_id>'' to carry refund context. '
470	  'Cumulative bounds check prevents over-reversal of parent tax amount.';
471	
472	REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION commission_split_tax_line_reverse(uuid, bigint, text, text) FROM PUBLIC;
473	GRANT  EXECUTE ON FUNCTION commission_split_tax_line_reverse(uuid, bigint, text, text) TO service_role;
474	
475	
476	-- =============================================================================
477	-- SECTION 6 — Replace commission_splits_drift_check with 4-leg version
478	--
479	-- Leg 1 (S17 unchanged): succeeded PIs missing kind='split' row.
480	-- Leg 2 (S17 unchanged): lost disputes missing kind='reversal' row.
481	-- Leg 3 (S17 unchanged): charges with tax_amount_cents > 0 missing kind='tax_line' children.
482	-- Leg 4 (S18 NEW): refunded/partially_refunded charges whose parent split has tax_line
483	--   children but none of those tax_line children have a kind='reversal' descendant.
484	--   Indicates Track A's commission_split_tax_line_reverse call failed post-refund.
485	--
486	-- Stability: STABLE (read-only across all 4 legs).
487	-- =============================================================================
488	
489	DROP FUNCTION IF EXISTS commission_splits_drift_check(timestamptz);
490	
491	CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION commission_splits_drift_check(p_since_timestamp timestamptz)
492	RETURNS jsonb
493	LANGUAGE plpgsql
494	STABLE
495	SECURITY DEFINER
496	SET search_path = public
497	AS $$
498	DECLARE
499	  v_pis_missing                   jsonb;
500	  v_disputes_missing              jsonb;
501	  v_charges_missing_tax_line      jsonb;
502	  v_refunds_missing_tax_reversal  jsonb;
503	BEGIN
504	  IF p_since_timestamp IS NULL THEN
505	    RAISE EXCEPTION
506	      'commission_splits_drift_check: p_since_timestamp must not be null';
507	  END IF;
508	
509	  -- ── Leg 1 (S17): succeeded PIs missing kind='split' ─────────────────────────
510	  SELECT COALESCE(
511	    jsonb_agg(
512	      jsonb_build_object(
513	        'payment_intent_id', sc.payment_intent_id,
514	        'charge_id',         sc.charge_id,
515	        'studio_id',         sc.studio_id,
516	        'created_at',        sc.created_at
517	      )
518	      ORDER BY sc.created_at
519	    ),
520	    '[]'::jsonb
521	  )
522	  INTO v_pis_missing
523	  FROM stripe_charges sc
524	  LEFT JOIN commission_splits cs
525	    ON  cs.booking_id = sc.booking_id
526	    AND cs.kind       = 'split'
527	  WHERE sc.status     = 'succeeded'
528	    AND sc.created_at >= p_since_timestamp
529	    AND sc.booking_id IS NOT NULL
530	    AND cs.id         IS NULL;
531	
532	  -- ── Leg 2 (S17): lost disputes missing kind='reversal' ───────────────────────
533	  SELECT COALESCE(
534	    jsonb_agg(
535	      jsonb_build_object(
536	        'dispute_id',  sd.dispute_id,
537	        'charge_id',   sd.charge_id,
538	        'studio_id',   sd.studio_id,
539	        'resolved_at', sd.resolved_at
540	      )
541	      ORDER BY sd.resolved_at
542	    ),
543	    '[]'::jsonb
544	  )
545	  INTO v_disputes_missing
546	  FROM stripe_disputes sd

556	         AND cs.booking_id IN (
557	               SELECT sc_inner.booking_id
558	                 FROM stripe_charges sc_inner
559	                WHERE sc_inner.charge_id  = sd.charge_id
560	                  AND sc_inner.booking_id IS NOT NULL
561	                LIMIT 1
562	             )
563	    );
564	
565	  -- ── Leg 3 (S17): charges with tax > 0 missing tax_line attribution ───────────
566	  SELECT COALESCE(
567	    jsonb_agg(
568	      jsonb_build_object(
569	        'payment_intent_id', sc.payment_intent_id,
570	        'charge_id',         sc.charge_id,
571	        'studio_id',         sc.studio_id,
572	        'tax_amount_cents',  sc.tax_amount_cents
573	      )
574	      ORDER BY sc.created_at
575	    ),
576	    '[]'::jsonb
577	  )
578	  INTO v_charges_missing_tax_line
579	  FROM stripe_charges sc
580	  INNER JOIN commission_splits parent
581	    ON  parent.booking_id = sc.booking_id
582	    AND parent.kind       = 'split'
583	  LEFT JOIN commission_splits taxlines
584	    ON  taxlines.parent_split_id = parent.id
585	    AND taxlines.kind            = 'tax_line'
586	  WHERE sc.status         = 'succeeded'
587	    AND sc.created_at    >= p_since_timestamp
588	    AND sc.booking_id    IS NOT NULL
589	    AND sc.tax_amount_cents > 0
590	    AND taxlines.id      IS NULL;
591	
592	  -- ── Leg 4 (S18): refunded charges with tax_line children missing tax reversals ─
593	  --
594	  -- Logic:
595	  --   1. Find stripe_charges with status IN ('refunded', 'partially_refunded')
596	  --      created since p_since_timestamp.
597	  --   2. For each such charge, find the parent kind='split' commission_splits row.
598	  --   3. Check that every kind='tax_line' child of that parent split has at least
599	  --      one kind='reversal' grandchild (i.e. a row with parent_split_id = taxline.id
600	  --      and kind='reversal').
601	  --   4. Return charges where at least one tax_line child has NO reversal descendant,
602	  --      including the list of un-reversed jurisdictions for alerting.
603	  --
604	  -- Note: we require the parent split to have been recorded (kind='split' child exists).
605	  -- Charges missing the parent split entirely are caught by Leg 1.
606	  SELECT COALESCE(
607	    jsonb_agg(
608	      jsonb_build_object(
609	        'payment_intent_id',    sc.payment_intent_id,
610	        'charge_id',            sc.charge_id,
611	        'studio_id',            sc.studio_id,
612	        'missing_jurisdictions', (
613	          SELECT COALESCE(
614	            jsonb_agg(tl.jurisdiction ORDER BY tl.jurisdiction),
615	            '[]'::jsonb
616	          )
617	          FROM commission_splits tl
618	         WHERE tl.parent_split_id = parent.id
619	           AND tl.kind            = 'tax_line'
620	           AND NOT EXISTS (
621	                 SELECT 1
622	                   FROM commission_splits rev
623	                  WHERE rev.parent_split_id = tl.id
624	                    AND rev.kind            = 'reversal'
625	               )
626	        )
627	      )
628	      ORDER BY sc.created_at
629	    ),
630	    '[]'::jsonb
631	  )
632	  INTO v_refunds_missing_tax_reversal
633	  FROM stripe_charges sc
634	  INNER JOIN commission_splits parent
635	    ON  parent.booking_id = sc.booking_id
636	    AND parent.kind       = 'split'
637	  WHERE sc.status        IN ('refunded', 'partially_refunded')
638	    AND sc.created_at   >= p_since_timestamp
639	    AND sc.booking_id   IS NOT NULL
640	    -- At least one tax_line child exists (charges with no tax don't need reversals)
641	    AND EXISTS (
642	          SELECT 1
643	            FROM commission_splits tl
644	           WHERE tl.parent_split_id = parent.id
645	             AND tl.kind            = 'tax_line'
646	        )
647	    -- At least one tax_line child is missing its reversal
648	    AND EXISTS (
649	          SELECT 1
650	            FROM commission_splits tl
651	           WHERE tl.parent_split_id = parent.id
652	             AND tl.kind            = 'tax_line'
653	             AND NOT EXISTS (
654	                   SELECT 1
655	                     FROM commission_splits rev
656	                    WHERE rev.parent_split_id = tl.id
657	                      AND rev.kind            = 'reversal'
658	                 )
659	        );
660	
661	  RETURN jsonb_build_object(
662	    'pis_missing_split',              v_pis_missing,
663	    'disputes_missing_reversal',      v_disputes_missing,
664	    'charges_missing_tax_line',       v_charges_missing_tax_line,
665	    'refunds_missing_tax_reversal',   v_refunds_missing_tax_reversal
666	  );
667	END;
668	$$;

675	  '(4) refunded/partially_refunded charges with tax_line children that have no '

677	  'Caller (cron) logs + alerts; does NOT auto-repair. '
678	  'Call with p_since_timestamp = now() - interval ''24 hours'' for daily sweeps.';
679

-- =============================================================================
-- SECTION 9 — RPC: tax_oss_quarterly_export
--
-- Spec : TaxOssQuarterlyExportArgs → TaxOssQuarterlyExportResult
-- Name : RPC.TAX_OSS_QUARTERLY_EXPORT = 'tax_oss_quarterly_export'
-- Params (3):
--   p_studio_id  uuid
--   p_year       int
--   p_quarter    int   (1–4)
-- Returns: jsonb (TaxOssQuarterlyExportResult shape)
-- Stability: STABLE (read-only)
-- Grant: service_role ONLY
--
-- Aggregates tax_remittance_ledger rows for EU jurisdictions in the given quarter.
-- EU jurisdiction detection: jurisdiction LIKE 'EU-%' OR country prefix in EU-27 list.
-- LEFT JOINs stripe_tax_registrations to annotate registration_status per jurisdiction.
-- Period key format: 'YYYY-QN' (e.g. '2026-Q1').
-- =============================================================================

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION tax_oss_quarterly_export(
  p_studio_id uuid,
  p_year      int,
  p_quarter   int
)
RETURNS jsonb
LANGUAGE plpgsql
STABLE
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path = public
AS $$
DECLARE
  v_period      text;
  v_rows        jsonb;
  v_total_cents bigint;
BEGIN
  -- ── Input validation ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  IF p_studio_id IS NULL THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'tax_oss_quarterly_export: p_studio_id must not be null';
  END IF;
  IF p_year IS NULL OR p_year < 2020 OR p_year > 2100 THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'tax_oss_quarterly_export: p_year must be between 2020 and 2100, got %', p_year;
  END IF;
  IF p_quarter IS NULL OR p_quarter NOT IN (1, 2, 3, 4) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'tax_oss_quarterly_export: p_quarter must be 1–4, got %', p_quarter;
  END IF;

  -- Period key matches tax_remittance_ledger.period format e.g. '2026-Q1'
  v_period := p_year::text || '-Q' || p_quarter::text;

  -- ── Aggregate EU ledger rows ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
  -- EU-27 countries detected by either:
  --   (a) jurisdiction LIKE 'EU-%'  (Stripe Tax uses EU-XX prefix for OSS)
  --   (b) substring(jurisdiction, 1, 2) is a known EU-27 country code
  SELECT COALESCE(
    jsonb_agg(
      jsonb_build_object(
        'jurisdiction',         trl.jurisdiction,
        'amount_collected_cents', trl.amount_collected_cents,
        'amount_remitted_cents',  trl.amount_remitted_cents,
        'period',               trl.period,
        'registration_status',  reg.status
      )
      ORDER BY trl.jurisdiction
    ),
    '[]'::jsonb
  )
  INTO v_rows
  FROM tax_remittance_ledger trl
  LEFT JOIN stripe_tax_registrations reg
    ON  reg.studio_id   = trl.studio_id
    AND reg.jurisdiction = trl.jurisdiction
    AND reg.status       = 'active'
  WHERE trl.studio_id = p_studio_id
    AND trl.period     = v_period
    AND (
      trl.jurisdiction LIKE 'EU-%'
      OR substring(trl.jurisdiction FROM 1 FOR 2) IN (
        'AT','BE','BG','CY','CZ','DE','DK','EE','ES','FI',
        'FR','GR','HR','HU','IE','IT','LT','LU','LV','MT',
        'NL','PL','PT','RO','SE','SI','SK'
      )
    );

  -- ── Total across all EU jurisdictions ────────────────────────────────────────
  SELECT COALESCE(SUM(trl.amount_collected_cents), 0)
    INTO v_total_cents
    FROM tax_remittance_ledger trl
   WHERE trl.studio_id = p_studio_id
     AND trl.period     = v_period
     AND (
       trl.jurisdiction LIKE 'EU-%'
       OR substring(trl.jurisdiction FROM 1 FOR 2) IN (
         'AT','BE','BG','CY','CZ','DE','DK','EE','ES','FI',
         'FR','GR','HR','HU','IE','IT','LT','LU','LV','MT',
         'NL','PL','PT','RO','SE','SI','SK'
       )
     );

  RETURN jsonb_build_object(
    'studio_id',          p_studio_id,
    'year',               p_year,
    'quarter',            p_quarter,
    'period',             v_period,
    'total_eu_tax_cents', v_total_cents,
    'jurisdictions',      v_rows
  );
END;
$$;

  'jurisdiction LIKE ''EU-%%'' or country prefix is in the EU-27 list. '
  'LEFT JOINs stripe_tax_registrations (status=active) to annotate registration_status '
  'per jurisdiction. Period key format: YYYY-QN (e.g. ''2026-Q1''). '
  'Returns TaxOssQuarterlyExportResult shape with jurisdictions array.';

-- =============================================================================
-- SECTION 10 — REPLACE commission_splits_drift_check (S18 → S19 refund-granular Leg 4)
--
-- S19 Leg 4 change:
--   S18 Leg 4 detected refunds by matching stripe_charges.status IN
--   ('refunded', 'partially_refunded'). This had a resolution gap: a charge
--   could be marked refunded but individual re_xxx refund objects may not yet
--   have landed in the database, causing false positives OR missed detections
--   when multiple partial refunds land at different times.
--
--   S19 Leg 4 uses stripe_refunds directly (per-refund granularity):
--   For each stripe_refunds row WHERE status='succeeded' AND created_at>=since:
--     1. Find the parent kind='split' commission_splits row via:
--            stripe_charges.payment_intent_id → stripe_charges.booking_id
--            → commission_splits (kind='split')
--     2. Find all kind='tax_line' children of that parent split.
--     3. For each tax_line child, check that a kind='reversal' row exists
--        WHERE tax_line_id LIKE 'refund:<refund_id>:%'
--        (matches the encoding set by commission_split_tax_line_reverse).
--     4. If any tax_line child is missing the scoped reversal, record the
--        refund as drifted with the list of missing jurisdictions.
--
--   Result row shape: { refund_id, payment_intent_id, studio_id, missing_jurisdictions[] }
--
-- Legs 1, 2, 3: verbatim from S18 (unchanged).
-- Leg 4: rewritten for per-refund granularity.
-- =============================================================================

DROP FUNCTION IF EXISTS commission_splits_drift_check(timestamptz);

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION commission_splits_drift_check(p_since_timestamp timestamptz)
RETURNS jsonb
LANGUAGE plpgsql
STABLE
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path = public
AS $$
DECLARE
  v_pis_missing                   jsonb;
  v_disputes_missing              jsonb;
  v_charges_missing_tax_line      jsonb;
  v_refunds_missing_tax_reversal  jsonb;
BEGIN
  IF p_since_timestamp IS NULL THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION
      'commission_splits_drift_check: p_since_timestamp must not be null';
  END IF;

  -- ── Leg 1 (S17, unchanged): succeeded PIs missing kind='split' ───────────────
  SELECT COALESCE(
    jsonb_agg(
      jsonb_build_object(
        'payment_intent_id', sc.payment_intent_id,
        'charge_id',         sc.charge_id,
        'studio_id',         sc.studio_id,
        'created_at',        sc.created_at
      )
      ORDER BY sc.created_at
    ),
    '[]'::jsonb
  )
  INTO v_pis_missing
  FROM stripe_charges sc
  LEFT JOIN commission_splits cs
    ON  cs.booking_id = sc.booking_id
    AND cs.kind       = 'split'
  WHERE sc.status     = 'succeeded'
    AND sc.created_at >= p_since_timestamp
    AND sc.booking_id IS NOT NULL
    AND cs.id         IS NULL;

  -- ── Leg 2 (S17, unchanged): lost disputes missing kind='reversal' ────────────
  SELECT COALESCE(
    jsonb_agg(
      jsonb_build_object(
        'dispute_id',  sd.dispute_id,
        'charge_id',   sd.charge_id,
        'studio_id',   sd.studio_id,
        'resolved_at', sd.resolved_at
      )
      ORDER BY sd.resolved_at
    ),
    '[]'::jsonb
  )
  INTO v_disputes_missing
  FROM stripe_disputes sd
  WHERE sd.status      = 'lost'
    AND sd.resolved_at >= p_since_timestamp
    AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
        FROM commission_splits cs
       WHERE cs.kind       = 'reversal'
         AND cs.studio_id  = sd.studio_id
         AND cs.created_at >= sd.resolved_at - interval '1 hour'
         AND cs.created_at <= sd.resolved_at + interval '24 hours'
         AND cs.booking_id IN (
               SELECT sc_inner.booking_id
                 FROM stripe_charges sc_inner
                WHERE sc_inner.charge_id  = sd.charge_id
                  AND sc_inner.booking_id IS NOT NULL
                LIMIT 1
             )
    );

  -- ── Leg 3 (S17, unchanged): charges with tax > 0 missing tax_line attribution ─
  SELECT COALESCE(
    jsonb_agg(
      jsonb_build_object(
        'payment_intent_id', sc.payment_intent_id,
        'charge_id',         sc.charge_id,
        'studio_id',         sc.studio_id,
        'tax_amount_cents',  sc.tax_amount_cents
      )
      ORDER BY sc.created_at
    ),
    '[]'::jsonb
  )
  INTO v_charges_missing_tax_line
  FROM stripe_charges sc
  INNER JOIN commission_splits parent
    ON  parent.booking_id = sc.booking_id
    AND parent.kind       = 'split'
  LEFT JOIN commission_splits taxlines
    ON  taxlines.parent_split_id = parent.id
    AND taxlines.kind            = 'tax_line'
  WHERE sc.status           = 'succeeded'
    AND sc.created_at      >= p_since_timestamp
    AND sc.booking_id      IS NOT NULL
    AND sc.tax_amount_cents  > 0
    AND taxlines.id         IS NULL;

  -- ── Leg 4 (S19): per-refund granularity — succeeded refunds missing scoped ────
  --                 tax_line reversals
  --
  -- For each succeeded stripe_refund, trace the chain:
  --   stripe_refunds.payment_intent_id
  --     → stripe_charges.payment_intent_id (get booking_id)
  --     → commission_splits parent (kind='split', booking_id)
  --     → commission_splits tax_line children (kind='tax_line', parent_split_id=parent.id)
  --     → check: each tax_line has a reversal WHERE tax_line_id LIKE 'refund:<refund_id>:%'
  --
  -- A refund is drifted when at least one tax_line child has no such scoped reversal.
  -- missing_jurisdictions lists the un-reversed jurisdictions for alerting.
  --
  -- Note: we require the parent split to exist. Charges missing parent split are caught
  -- by Leg 1, not here. We also only flag refunds whose parent charge has tax_line
  -- children — no-tax charges have no reversal requirement.
  SELECT COALESCE(
    jsonb_agg(
      jsonb_build_object(
        'refund_id',             sr.refund_id,
        'payment_intent_id',     sr.payment_intent_id,
        'studio_id',             sr.studio_id,
        'missing_jurisdictions', (
          SELECT COALESCE(
            jsonb_agg(tl.jurisdiction ORDER BY tl.jurisdiction),
            '[]'::jsonb
          )
          FROM commission_splits tl
         WHERE tl.parent_split_id = parent.id
           AND tl.kind            = 'tax_line'
           AND NOT EXISTS (
                 SELECT 1
                   FROM commission_splits rev
                  WHERE rev.parent_split_id = tl.id
                    AND rev.kind            = 'reversal'
                    AND rev.tax_line_id     LIKE 'refund:' || sr.refund_id || ':%'
               )
        )
      )
      ORDER BY sr.created_at
    ),
    '[]'::jsonb
  )
  INTO v_refunds_missing_tax_reversal
  FROM stripe_refunds sr
  INNER JOIN stripe_charges sc
    ON  sc.payment_intent_id = sr.payment_intent_id
    AND sc.booking_id        IS NOT NULL
  INNER JOIN commission_splits parent
    ON  parent.booking_id = sc.booking_id
    AND parent.kind       = 'split'
  WHERE sr.status         = 'succeeded'
    AND sr.created_at    >= p_since_timestamp
    -- Only flag refunds where the parent charge has at least one tax_line child
    AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
            FROM commission_splits tl
           WHERE tl.parent_split_id = parent.id
             AND tl.kind            = 'tax_line'
        )
    -- At least one tax_line child is missing the scoped reversal for this refund
    AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1

             AND tl.kind            = 'tax_line'

    jsonb_agg(elem ORDER BY (elem->>'refund_id')),
    '[]'::jsonb

  INTO v_refunds_missing_tax_reversal
  FROM jsonb_array_elements(v_refunds_missing_tax_reversal) AS elem
  WHERE jsonb_array_length(elem->'missing_jurisdictions') > 0;

  RETURN jsonb_build_object(
    'pis_missing_split',             v_pis_missing,
    'disputes_missing_reversal',     v_disputes_missing,
    'charges_missing_tax_line',      v_charges_missing_tax_line,
    'refunds_missing_tax_reversal',  v_refunds_missing_tax_reversal
  );
END;
